tools.name: fub_get_identity
tools.description: Who the credential belongs to: the account (id, domain, owner) and the authenticated user. A cheap way to confirm the API key works. FUB: GET /v1/identity.

tools.name: fub_search_people
tools.description: Search contacts and leads. Criteria combine with AND. Name filters are partial matches. Newest first by default. People in the Trash stage are excluded unless includeTrash is true. Not every field is returned by default — pass `fields` (e.g. "allFields" or a comma list) for more. FUB: GET /v1/people

tools.name: fub_get_person
tools.description: Fetch one contact by id. Pass fields="allFields" to include custom fields and everything else. FUB: GET /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_check_duplicate_person
tools.description: Check if a contact with this email or phone already exists anywhere in the account (even ones this user cannot see) and who it is assigned to. Use before adding a lead. FUB: GET /v1/people/checkDuplicate.

tools.name: fub_list_events
tools.description: Lead activity: registrations, inquiries, viewed/saved properties, website visits, etc. Filter by person or type. Some events are only visible in the FUB app. FUB: GET /v1/events.

tools.name: fub_list_calls
tools.description: Logged phone calls with outcome, direction and duration. Filter by person or number. FUB: GET /v1/calls.

tools.name: fub_list_text_messages
tools.description: Text messages for a person or a phone number (message bodies may be hidden by FUB for privacy). FUB: GET /v1/textMessages.

tools.name: fub_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks (follow-ups, calls, showings…). Filter by person, assignee, type, completion, or due window (due="today"|"overdue"|"upcoming"). FUB: GET /v1/tasks.

tools.name: fub_list_appointments
tools.description: Calendar appointments with invitees, type and outcome. Filter by person, user, or a start+end window (both required together). FUB: GET /v1/appointments.

tools.name: fub_list_deals
tools.description: Deals (transactions) with stage, price, people, agents and commission. Filter by pipeline, user, person or status. The response metadata includes totalByStageId. FUB: GET /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_list_pipelines
tools.description: Deal pipelines with their stages (the stage ids that fub_create_deal / fub_update_deal take). FUB: GET /v1/pipelines.

tools.name: fub_list_stages
tools.description: Contact lifecycle stages (Lead, Nurture, Past Client, Trash…) with people counts — the names fub_search_people and fub_update_person take as "stage". FUB: GET /v1/stages.

tools.name: fub_list_users
tools.description: Users in the account (agents, brokers, lenders) — the ids to assign people, tasks and deals to. FUB: GET /v1/users.

tools.name: fub_list_custom_fields
tools.description: The account's contact custom fields: label, API name (customXxx), type and dropdown choices. Use the name as a key in customFields. FUB: GET /v1/customFields.

tools.name: fub_send_lead_event
tools.description: Add a new lead or record activity on an existing one — FUB's documented way to create leads. FUB de-duplicates by email/phone (or use person.id to target a contact), routes the lead per Lead Flow, notifies the agent and runs action plans for Registration / Inquiry types. tools.name: fub_update_person
tools.description: Update a contact's fields. CAUTION: `tags` REPLACES all tags unless mergeTags is true; `phones` and `emails` REPLACE the full list (send existing ones too). Setting contacted=true pauses action plans. source/sourceUrl cannot be changed after creation. FUB: PUT /v1/people/{id}.

tools.name: fub_add_note
tools.description: Add a note to a contact's timeline. FUB: POST /v1/notes.

tools.name: fub_log_call
tools.description: Record a phone call made or received outside FUB, with its outcome. Does not place a call. FUB: POST /v1/calls.

tools.name: fub_create_task
tools.description: Create a task on a contact, assigned to a user (assignedUserId or assignedTo is required). FUB: POST /v1/tasks.

tools.name: fub_update_task
tools.description: Update a task — mark it complete, rename, retype or reassign it. FUB: PUT /v1/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: fub_create_deal
tools.description: Create a deal in a pipeline stage (stage ids from fub_list_pipelines). Include userIds — a deal with no users is invisible to agents. FUB: POST /v1/deals.

tools.name: fub_update_deal
tools.description: Update a deal — move it to another stage, change price, dates, people or agents. peopleIds/userIds replace the full list. FUB: PUT /v1/deals/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_list_text_messages, fub_update_person · Private data: fub_get_identity, fub_search_people, fub_get_person, fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_list_stages, fub_list_custom_fields, fub_send_lead_event, fub_update_person, fub_add_note, fub_log_call, fub_create_task · Public sink: fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_send_lead_event, fub_update_person, fub_add_note, fub_log_call, fub_create_task, fub_create_deal.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_list_text_messages, fub_update_person · Private data: fub_get_identity, fub_search_people, fub_get_person, fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_list_stages, fub_list_custom_fields, fub_send_lead_event, fub_update_person, fub_add_note, fub_log_call, fub_create_task · Public sink: fub_check_duplicate_person, fub_send_lead_event, fub_update_person, fub_add_note, fub_log_call, fub_create_task, fub_create_deal

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
